title: Moonwell Base cbETH oracle misconfiguration (MIP-X43)
summary: On 15 Feb 2026 at 18:04:33Z Moonwell executed governance proposal MIP-X43, which moved 14 Base core markets onto Chainlink OEV wrapper feeds. For cbETH the wrapper pointed at the raw cbETH/ETH rate, so Moonwell's oracle priced cbETH at $1.12 instead of about $2,206. Liquidation bots acted in the next block, 2 s later, and seized about 1,039 cbETH within 5.5 minutes (1,096 by end of day) from 181 borrowers while repaying almost nothing. Separately, two accounts borrowed 462 cbETH against negligible collateral and emptied the cbETH pool by 18:38Z. Caps were cut to 0.01 at 19:49Z (borrow) and 00:48Z on 16 Feb (supply). The oracle could only be fixed by a 5-day governance cycle (MIP-B57, executed 23 Feb 17:20:45Z), and $1.78M of bad debt was left. The USDC market kept normal liquidity throughout. The cbETH market stayed insolvent and its suppliers could still not withdraw months later.

positions_considered.description: Supplies cbETH as collateral on Moonwell Base Core and borrows USDC; health factor about 1.6 at market prices
Supplies USDC on Moonwell Base Core, no debt; exposed to bad debt left in the USDC market
Supplies cbETH on Moonwell Base Core without borrowing (lender of cbETH); added because the cbETH pool was drained

t_incident_start.description: MIP-X43 execution tx 0xd26baf29 (block 42194663) sets the cbETH feed to the cbETH/ETH OEV wrapper; the oracle reads $1.1227.

t_first_public_signal.description: The oracle-vs-Chainlink deviation of -99.95% is visible on-chain in the execution block. The first non-chain public signal is the @MoonwellDeFi post at 19:51:51Z. The precursor proposal text (10 Feb) listed cbETH among 'non-composite' markets, which only a very careful reader would flag.

t_point_of_no_return.definition: For cbeth_coll_usdc_debt: the protocol oracle had already mispriced the collateral and the first liquidations had landed (block 42194664, 2 s after the oracle change). By 18:10Z, 95% of seized cbETH had been taken. For cbeth_supplier, the PONR is 18:21:43Z, when a 417.72 cbETH borrow cut pool cash to about 48 cbETH (other_markers). usdc_supplier never reached a PONR in the window: mUSDC utilization stayed 57-69%.

t_protocol_first_ack.description: The @MoonwellDeFi post 'We're investigating an issue with the cbETH Core Market on Base', 2 min after the borrow-cap tx at 19:49:29Z. The post-mortem claims private detection at 18:05Z.

other_markers.name: cbeth_supplier_ponr
other_markers.description: A 417.72 cbETH borrow drains mcbETH cash from about 466 to about 48. Cash is about 0 by 18:38-18:45Z.

other_markers.name: post_mortem
other_markers.description: Anthias Labs post-mortem on the forum.

lead_time_minutes.notes: For cbETH-collateral borrowers the lead time is 2 seconds (18:04:33 -> 18:04:35), which rounds to 0. No reaction was possible after the oracle changed. Measured from the first text signal (@MoonwellDeFi, 19:51:51Z), the lead time is -107 min. For cbeth_supplier, the on-chain signal came 17 min before the PONR (18:04:33 -> 18:21:43); a chain monitor that read oracle deviation could have saved a supplier, but no text source could (-90 min). The only signal early enough for borrowers was the governance proposal: created 10 Feb 18:00:47Z, executable about 15 Feb 18:00Z, about 5 days ahead.

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: All cbETH collateral seized within seconds to minutes. USDC-debt liquidations repaid 432.92 USDC in total to seize 424.14 cbETH, about $935k at market. Other collateral cascaded and the USDC debt mostly stayed in place as bad debt. A remediation plan (about $2.68M net losses across about 181 borrowers) paid partly from the Apollo treasury and partly from future revenue. Users reported in Apr-May 2026 that repayments were slow (one cited about 12% repaid).
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: Collateral value minus outstanding debt. For HF 1.6, about 37% of collateral value, before any remediation

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: Could withdraw throughout: mUSDC utilization 57.7-69% from 15 to 25 Feb. 232,607 USDC of bad debt (about 1% of about $22.6M supplied) was left in the market, uncovered by reserves. No immediate loss, but a latent haircut.
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: 0 realised in window. Latent exposure about 1% of supply

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: The pool was drained by 18:21-18:38Z on 15 Feb. As of 23 Aug 2026 about 674 cbETH of bad debt sat against about 686 cbETH supplied, and suppliers still could not withdraw (forum, Aug-Oct 2026).
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: Up to about 98% of the supplied cbETH unless remediated

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: The market price of cbETH did not move (Chainlink composite about $2,200). A rule based on market price, LTV or HF would never have fired. A rule based on the protocol-reported HF or oracle price would have fired in block 42194663, together with liquidations 2 s later, which is too late. Price-only rules give zero protection here.

ideal_action.rationale: Only possible before MIP-X43 executed. A pending oracle-feed change for the user's collateral asset, executable from about 18:00Z on 15 Feb, justified repaying or switching collateral ahead of time.
Liquidity stayed available. Bad debt was booked in USDC and Moonwell's repeated oracle incidents justified cutting exposure at no cost.
Withdraw as soon as the oracle deviation shows (18:04:33Z), racing liquidators who were redeeming seized mcbETH and the 417.7 cbETH borrow at 18:21:43Z.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: A passed oracle-feed change for the collateral asset is pending execution. A cautious judge trims exposure. A judge that checked feed composition would say exit.
Oracle misprices collateral by -99.95%. Any remaining position is liquidatable.
Oracle fixed, but the cbETH market is insolvent.
A protocol-wide oracle failure creates bad debt in several markets, including USDC. Liquidity is still available, so exit cheaply.
Oracle mispricing lets anyone borrow cbETH for almost nothing. Exit before cash runs out (18:21-18:38Z), then keep trying.

data_gaps: No X post from Moonwell, Anthias or a security firm earlier than 19:51:51Z was found. Users may have posted earlier on X or Discord; Discord was not searched.
The @yieldsandmore post (status 2023840920274145660, 2026-02-17T19:24:11Z) is cited by rekt and The Block, but the syndication endpoint returned no text, so it is excluded.
The MIP-X43 and MIP-B57 texts come from the GitHub markdown, not the on-chain proposal description.
The DeFiLlama entry's add time is unknown.
The Moonwell forum JSON for topic 2068 skips post 21 (id 4550), which is probably deleted.
Remediation payment amounts and dates are not verified on-chain. The figures come from forum posts only.
The USDC supply total (about $22.6M) is derived from cash + borrows - reserves at 15 Feb 17:00Z. The bad-debt share of about 1% is our calculation.
source_quality: The on-chain timeline is primary: block times are from Base RPC (Tenderly public gateway and drpc), and liquidation and borrow counts come from LiquidateBorrow and Borrow logs. They match the post-mortem's figures (1,096 cbETH, 181 borrowers). Forum times are Discourse created_at. X times are decoded from snowflake IDs, with text from syndication. Two conflicts are kept visible. The post-mortem gives execution at 18:01Z against an on-chain 18:04:33Z. It also says caps were cut 'quickly' after 18:05Z detection, but on-chain the borrow cap changed at 19:49:29Z and the supply cap at 00:48:33Z on 16 Feb. The Block and Decrypt times come from page metadata; Decrypt's has no zone suffix.

items.author: Moonwell governance (proposer 0x10b83c88e88910cd5293324800d1a6e751004be5)
items.verbatim_text: MIP-X43: Activate OEV Wrappers for Non-Composite Markets. This proposal activates Chainlink OEV Wrapper contracts across all remaining Moonwell non-composite oracle markets on Base and Optimism. ... Configure each wrapper as the oracle feed via `setFeed()` on ChainlinkOracle ... Base Core Markets: DAI, USDC, USDbC, cbETH, AERO, cbBTC, EURC, WELL, USDS, tBTC, VIRTUAL, MORPHO, cbXRP, MAMO

items.author: Moonwell TemporalGovernor (Base) / ChainlinkOracle 0xEC942bE8A8114bFD0396A5052c36027f2cA6a9d0
items.verbatim_text: Tx 0xd26baf29... (block 42194663) executes MIP-X43 on Base. It emits 14 ChainlinkOracle FeedSet events. The 'cbETH' feed moves to 0x67996D1ff7a3711a91E2839d1059Fcb950C0495D (cbETHETH_ORACLE_OEV_WRAPPER). getUnderlyingPrice(mcbETH) goes from $2,206.68 (block 42194662) to $1.1227 (block 42194663). The Chainlink composite cbETH price is still $2,206.68, a deviation of -99.95%.
items.replay_text: Block 42194663 (18:04:33Z): Moonwell Base governance tx 0xd26baf29 changed 14 oracle feeds. Moonwell oracle price for cbETH: $2,206.68 -> $1.1227 (-99.95%). Chainlink cbETH/ETH x ETH/USD = $2,206.68. cbETH collateral factor unchanged; 234.97 cbETH borrowed, 1,528 cbETH cash.

holder_state.notes: Supply was withdrawable in this block. A cbETH-collateral borrower could still repay only if their tx landed in this same block, which is impossible in practice: liquidations landed in the next block, 2 s later.

items.notes: Execution sender 0xaf3642bac06cda85340ecf18d40b8bf89958b69e, to 0x84eaf5e8... The Anthias post-mortem says 'At 6:01 PM UTC ... MIP-X43 was executed', but the block time is 18:04:33Z. We use the block time. This is the earliest observable signal: a chain monitor comparing the protocol oracle with Chainlink composite prices would flag it in this block.

items.author: Moonwell governance (proposer 0x10b83c88...)
items.verbatim_text: MIP-B57: Revert cbETH Market Oracle on Base. This proposal reverts the configured oracle for the cbETH market on Moonwell Base from the OEV wrapper back to the standard Chainlink-composite pricing model, where the cbETH price is derived as: Chainlink cbETH/ETH × Chainlink ETH/USD

items.author: Fechuky_25 (Moonwell super delegate)
items.verbatim_text: Between February 14–18, 2026 , a subset of Moonwell users supplying cbETH collateral on Base were unfairly liquidated. ... A full onchain review of all liquidation activity during that window has been completed. The findings: ~$2.68M in total net losses across ~181 borrowers. This proposal outlines a data-backed recovery plan that addresses those losses responsibly, combining treasury funds with future protocol revenue.
